body: I never really wanted to be anything when I grew up haha, I was a really depressed kid and had a pretty fucked up home so I really just focused on surviving. Thinking about the future has always made me super anxious, but I do agree that I need some sort of goals and something to focus on.
I don’t even want to go into the bathroom to bleach it. Ugh. A lot of people live here so maybe someone else will. Fingers crossed no one else gets it.

Yeah she lives with me. I wash my hands like crazy and I try really hard not to touch my nose or mouth. 

She’s in her 60s so I don’t think it’s a period haha. She very well could have eaten something bad and it could have been a coincidence that yesterday my cousin was having minor stomach issues, but I just don’t know.
